releaseTitle: ATalk v3.5.0 — Telegram Keyboard Synchronization, Inward Centered Reactions, Pinned Media Picker & Lightbox Insets Fix
releaseNotes:
• Keyboard Inset Auto-Scroll: Messages dynamically glide upwards when the keyboard opens, keeping the latest messages fully visible directly above the input bar.
• Symmetrical Inward Reactions: Reacted emojis mirror symmetrically towards the center of the chat from both incoming and outgoing bubbles.
• Compact Telegram Input Bar: Removed redundant HD and View-Once buttons from the text bar, reducing bar height to a sleek 40dp.
• Pinned Media Picker Footer: In-app media picker bottom sheet opens directly without clipping; Send button, selection count, HD toggle, and new ① View-Once toggle are pinned securely at the bottom.
• Status Media Composer Screen Insets: Fully responsive Scaffold layout with statusBarsPadding, navigationBarsPadding, and imePadding so caption input and WhatsApp-green Post button never overflow or hide behind keyboard.
• Lightbox Navigation Bar Protection: Fullscreen media viewer's Save and Share buttons are elevated above 3-button and gesture navigation bars.
